2610.04212.title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
2610.04212.paper_summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.
2610.04212.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經運算子（GNOs）提供靈活的替代模型，用於學習偏微分方程（PDEs）的解運算子。<lb/>然而，標準的 GNO 通常使用單一的神經網絡對積分核進行參數化，並在圖邊上評估核交互，這在高解析度或大鄰域下會導致相當大的計算和記憶體開銷。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了功能性張量分解圖神經運算子（FTD-GNO），這是一個記憶體高效的 GNO 框架，將高維連續積分核解耦為低維模式函數。<lb/>通過使用經典的張量分解格式來實例化核，包括 CP、張量列和塔克分解，FTD-GNO 使得積分運算子的代數重建成為可能，而無需顯式生成完整的邊緣核張量。<lb/>這種因式分解的表述減少了核評估和聚合的記憶體佔用，同時保留了 GNOs 的連續運算子學習結構。<lb/>理論複雜度分析顯示，FTD-GNO 顯著降低了與高維核構建相關的參數和激活記憶體成本。<lb/>實驗顯示，其峰值記憶體低於相應的未因式分解圖積分基準，並且訓練時間更短。<lb/>傅里葉圖實驗進一步證明，FTD 可以提高混合運算子中圖積分層的效率，並具有良好的可擴展性。
